data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for customizable balloon‑style tooltips.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that displays a tooltip balloon with configurable direction, size, colors, shadows, and animation. It can be shown or hidden programmatically and reacts to route changes.
use_when: You need a simple, customizable tooltip without writing custom overlay code
You want control over tooltip appearance such as arrow size, border, and padding
avoid_when: You require a full‑featured tooltip system with advanced positioning logic
strengths: Supports route‑aware hiding and tap callbacks
data.minimal_example:
SimpleTooltip(
  tooltipTap: () => print('Tooltip tap'),
  animationDuration: Duration(seconds: 3),
  show: true,
  tooltipDirection: TooltipDirection.up,
  child: Container(width: 200, height: 120, child: Placeholder()),
  content: Text('Some text example!!!!'),
);
